payload.title: Tell editors a change reaches the public site in a few minutes
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-11-05: he accepted the video on Machines on Machines, checked the Videos page at once, saw nothing and thought it had failed; the home-page snapshot runs after a debounce of up to about 5 minutes. When an editor accepts, rejects, rates or edits something that changes public pages, the Newsroom confirmation says it will be live on the site in a few minutes. Plain words, no colour alone. Gherkin. Later, when blocks read indexes (PPY-7f1e54), the wait may shrink; keep the wording honest to the real delay.
